description: This source file contains the implementation of initialization and deinitialization functions for the RDK logger module, including environment setup, signal handling, and logging configuration.

methods.name: rdk_logger_init
methods.description: Initializes the RDK logger, sets environment variables, initializes debug support, and configures logging, including handling SIGPIPE signals.

methods.name: rdk_logger_deinit
methods.description: Cleans up the logger, deinitializes dynamic logging, removes environment configurations, and finalizes logging system.
